info.title: x402-transfer-market
info.description:
Transfer or resell held bookings between wallets — signed listings and reassigned booking tokens, all in-response

Paid routes are settled with x402 (HTTP 402) in USDC on **Base or Solana** — the client picks the rail from the 402 `accepts` array.
